about.description: SPYX is an ETF perpetual listed on Delta Exchange India, tracking State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, margined and cash-settled in USD. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 25× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
